login.title: Sign in

login.linkHint: Open the link from the email on this device.

errors.invalid_login_token: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new one.
errors.invalid_login_code: This code is invalid, expired or already used.

errors.origin_not_allowed: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page.

errors.invalid_image: The file is damaged or is not a readable image.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The file was damaged during upload. Try again.

errors.upload_incomplete: The file did not finish uploading. Retry.

ended.limit: The 5-minute limit was reached and recording stopped. What was recorded is kept.

voice.discardConfirm: Delete this recording? It has not been saved and cannot be recovered.

errors.microphone_busy: The microphone is in use by another app or a call.
errors.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Update iOS or open the app in Safari.
errors.insecure: Audio recording works only over a secure connection (HTTPS).
errors.format_unsupported: The browser records audio in an unsupported format.
errors.recording_failed: Audio could not be recorded. Try again.
